dateScopeObservations: The cover states Study at Taiyuan University of Technology and has no intake year or application cutoff.
Page 2 has enrolment categories and preparatory foundation but no application cutoff.

Page 3 lists Chemical Engineering and Technology under Doctoral Degree, Mechanical Engineering under Master's Degree, and Teaching Chinese to Speakers of Other Languages under Bachelor's Degree; no application cutoff is present.
Page 4 separately names Shanxi Government Scholarship and TYUT Scholarship but gives no applicant cutoff.
Page 5 contains campus and dormitory photographs.
Page 6 contains admission process and fees but no application cutoff.
